rules.statement: In Kandyan law, where a person dies intestate and without issue, the brothers inherit before the sisters the acquired property of the deceased.
rules.supporting_quote: "The principle followed by the District Judge is in accordance with the decided cases. In Dingiri Menika v. Appuhamy (supra) this Court held with some hesitation on the authority of a passage in Sawer's Kandyan Law, page 13, that where Kandyan died intestate and without issue the lands acquired by him devolve on his uterine half-brother to the exclusion of his uterine half-sisters."
